content.short: RaceFi is a decentralized car racing game built with Web3 infrastructure.
content.description: RaceFi centers all playable and collectible elements on verifiably owned NFTs, so every ownable part of the game is represented by a token you truly own and can transfer. This setup guarantees clear ownership and smooth transfer of items, upgrades, and in-game property across the RaceFi ecosystem. Players can earn rewards by competing in multiple game modes, while strategic ownership of property provides additional ways to generate value over time. The combination of NFT ownership and varied racing modes creates tangible incentives to play and invest in the universe.
